name: ritual_altar_dressing
description: Four offerings for the hacienda altar tiers (and the study-to-loft hoop clue), drawn strictly from above with four distinct silhouettes (ring + tail, stack of rectangles, low blob, square box).

item_details.note: Embroidery hoop (~30 px ring) with 23-px loose thread tail pointing E; also dropped on the study floor pointing at the loft door.
3 axis-aligned folded letters (28x18 each, offset 3 px) bound by one vertical #4f3b28 strap (no cross).
Chapel wax: 3 unlit candle stubs of clearly different heights (tallest lightest) with off-centre 1x2 wicks, drips running into one flat #605551 pool with an irregular edge (~44x23 inside the rim).
Almud grain measure (34x34 wooden box, 3-px walls with #2e2219 corner joints) heaped with white maize kernels.
